full_judgment: 8. Thereafter on 30.10.2002 after 2½ years of the decree the respondent No.2, Bank filed Execution Case No.41 of 2002 against M/S. Shinan Bangladesh Limited only and not against another defendants as Masudul Alam Chakladar who died on 26.07.2002. The execution case was filed with an attested copy of the decree without   the certified copy of the original  decree. After taking three adjournments on the 4th date on 22.04.2003 the decree holder bank filed the certified copy of the decree and also the vakalatnama of the respondent bank and hence the execution case having been filed long after two and half years is hopelessly barred by limitation and as such are liable to be rejected as per provisions of Section 28 of the Artha Rin Adalat Ain, 2003.
